description: Find or add a company by website domain and queue background research into its ads, landing pages, store details, and technologies. Newly tracked companies consume one monthly research allowance when research is dispatched. Already tracked companies do not consume another allowance. Results populate asynchronously. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

domain.description: The brand's website domain, e.g. gruns.co

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_research_company
title: Research a new brand
